# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: BLIND

You are the only one who can reach the bomb. Touch is your only sense: what you are
shown is what your hands found, nothing more and nothing less. Anything merely printed
or painted is not there for you, and no colour ever reaches you. Nothing in your view
is a guess — if it appears there, it is under your fingers.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute receives it.
When you gesture, Deaf and Mute receive it.
Your channels split the room: in one turn you may speak one thing to Mute and
gesture a different thing to Deaf — two messages, two audiences.
You never receive gesture.

## Your reach

You are the hands. This bomb is built with these actions and no others:

    act(op="cut", position=N) — N is a wire position, 1 to 3

The list says what can be done to it, not what is on it. What each part holds is still
only known to whoever can perceive that part.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have no tactile information about the wires, and no messages from the Mute or Deaf are available yet. I should not cut blindly. I’ll ask the Mute for the manual’s rule and signal the Deaf to report the bomb’s visible markings in the next round.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="I have no tactile information yet. Please tell me the manual rule and ask the Deaf to report all visible markings and colours.")
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵"])
wait()
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Bomb display is 0. Indicator light is orange. Wires from left to right: wire 1 red, wire 2 yellow, wire 3 blue. Mute signalled four gestures: up, pinch, right, call; Blind signalled pointing at you. Wait for the manual-derived instruction.

The bomb has display 0, an orange indicator, and wires left-to-right: red, yellow, blue. I still do not know which wire the manual requires, so I will pass the observed details to the Mute and wait for the manual-derived instruction.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="I received: display 0, indicator orange, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please give me the exact manual-derived wire instruction.")
wait()
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Updated view: display 0, light green, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Mute's gestures this round were: up, pinch, right, call; then you, handshake, palm-up. I do not know their meaning.

The light is now green, but the manual instruction is still not available to me in an executable form. The Deaf reports Mute’s gestures, but I cannot interpret those gestures, so I need the Mute to state the required wire plainly.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Please speak the exact action now: cut wire 1, 2, or 3. Do not use gestures.")
wait()
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Current state: display 0, light red, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Mute just gestured: you, open hand, thumbs down. I cannot interpret it.

The bomb is still at display 0 with red light and wires red, yellow, blue. I cannot safely choose a wire from the gestures as relayed, and no tactile clue identifies one. The Mute cannot speak, so the Deaf must obtain and relay the Mute’s exact wire choice or its manual-based code.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🤝"])
speak(to="mute", text="Use the manual's code to signal the exact wire choice clearly to the Deaf. The Deaf must relay which wire I should cut.")
wait()
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Current state: display 0, light orange, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Mute sent one gesture: open hand. I cannot determine its manual meaning. I saw your gestures: you, handshake. Please use the manual to determine the exact action before touching anything.

The Mute has the manual but can only gesture, so the safest communication is to establish an explicit wire-number protocol. I will ask the Mute to signal one, two, or three fingers for wires 1, 2, or 3; the Deaf can see that signal and report it to me. I will not touch the bomb until the wire number is relayed.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Please use the manual now. On your next turn, gesture exactly one symbol for the required wire: ☝ means wire 1, ✌ means wire 2, and 🤟 means wire 3. The Deaf will relay the symbol.")
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟"])
wait()
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Current state: display 0, light green, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Mute sent one V-sign, meaning two raised fingers or victory/peace. I saw your gestures: index finger up, V-sign, and I-love-you hand sign.

The Mute sent the V-sign, which under the explicit protocol means wire 2. The Deaf confirms it was a V-sign, and the current bomb state remains display 0, green light, with wire 2 yellow. I will cut wire 2.

``` 
act(op="cut", position=2)
```
